reason: The FAQ fully covers password reset (F01), no always-human rule applies, and the customer is blocked but there is a clear self-service workaround.
replyEn: Hi Marloes, go to app.roosterly.nl/login and click "Wachtwoord vergeten" (Forgot password). Enter your email address. The reset link is valid for 60 minutes. If you have not received an email within 10 minutes, check your spam folder. Kind regards, Team Roosterly
